# Nick Esselman

Nick Esselman is a Netherlands-based full-stack developer and maker working across software, virtual reality, games, hardware, LED systems and custom PCB design.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://nickesselman.nl/): Profile, selected work and current activity.
- [PartyVR](https://github.com/Nickdev8/PartyVR): Room-scale multiplayer VR platform with host and spectator systems.
- [LAMP](https://github.com/Nickdev8/LedScreen): RP2040 controller for chained LED panels.
- [MYMacropad](https://github.com/Nickdev8/macropad): Custom 4×4 macropad, from PCB and firmware to enclosure.
- [Shelly Control Board](https://github.com/Nickdev8/kennemer): Local-first control interface for Shelly-powered devices.
- [Monkey Swing](https://nikkcc.itch.io/ms): A finished Unity swing game.
- [Blipstorm](https://nikkcc.itch.io/blipstorm): A playable Godot island-defence prototype.
